label: v223
changes: Fixed: Medical checks was showing every past medical-sounding calendar entry as "Overdue" forever — a plain calendar event has no way to know if the appointment happened, unlike a real referral, so past ones now drop off instead of piling up.

New: an "Extended family & friends' birthdays" section under Birthdays on the Family Calendar, plus its own tab to add people (grandparents, aunts/uncles, godparents, friends) who aren't family members here.
New: a Vacation countdown section — tag a calendar event Travel and see the days-until count on the Family Calendar.

Anniversaries & special days: Mother's Day, Father's Day and Women's Day now have accurate quick-add chips per country — Father's Day is the 2nd Sunday of June in Austria but the 3rd in South Africa, and Women's Day means two different dates (8 March international, 9 August South Africa's public holiday).
The guided setup's "Welcome back" header now reads clearly in bold black rather than a small pastel tag.
